title: Head of Product Sales I Vendor Lease
full_description:
Product Relationship Management
At ING Lease, we’re redefining leasing. AsHead of Sales – Vendor Lease, you’ll be at the forefront of innovation, driving growth and building partnerships that transform the way businesses finance their ambitions. This is your chance topush the business forward, create new opportunities, and make a real impact in a dynamic market. You’ll lead a talented team, attract strategic partnerships, and co-create propositions that set new standards in the industry.
Your Role & Work Environment
You coordinate, motivate, and coach the commercial team of Vendor Account Managers at ING Lease. You create visibility in the market and within ING. The Vendor Lease business involves developing strong long-term partnerships with manufacturers, importers, and dealers of capital goods, integrating financing as a sales or business support tool for partners in all relevant sectors: Equipment, Logistics Solutions, Medical & Technology Solutions.
Beyond leading the team, you push the business forward by identifying growth opportunities, attracting new partnerships (both vendor and referral), and setting up scalable structures. You work closely with partners to shape and refine our propositions, ensuring they remain competitive and innovative.
You initiate and coordinate actions and projects to achieve the targeted growth in new vendor leasing production and profitability as efficiently as possible. You take on the role of Squad Lead and build bridges with Risk colleagues and colleagues within the CLT Vendor Lease.
Your team consists of two specialized commercial Lease profiles. You report to the Director Digital Sales and Business Development of ING Lease. Together with other colleagues at ING Lease, you strive for optimal client and vendor satisfaction.
Your Main Responsibilities
Drive business developmentby identifying growth opportunities and attracting new vendor and referral partnerships.
Collaborate with partnersto co-create and evolve our propositions to meet market needs.
Lead and inspirea team of Vendor Account Managers, coaching them to deliver exceptional results.
You ensure effective and impactfulcommunicationwith colleagues at ING Lease and ING Bank.
During the weekly credit committee, you defend credit files together with the account managers. You make credit decisions as aFront decision-makerin the daily credit committee.
Take on the role ofSquad Lead, fostering collaboration across teams and driving initiatives that move us forward.
What We Are Looking For
We are looking for a colleague with the talent to take on responsibilities and deliver results, who is enthusiastic about helping others succeed, and has the ability to always stay one step ahead. In other words, you strive to bring fresh ideas and embrace challenges in a rapidly changing and complex environment. You are someone who always collaborates, listens, and invests in others to achieve shared goals. You enjoy challenging the status quo and are eager to propose creative solutions to problems.
As Head of Sales Vendor ING Lease, you should also:
Preferably have a master’s degree (in economics or law)
Have at least 5 years of experience in a commercial role, with leadership experience being a plus
Knowledge of financial, fiscal-legal, and accounting matters (or willingness to learn)
Be willing to deeply immerse yourself in the product and the world of leasing
Have a thorough knowledge of Dutch, French, and English
Ability to inspire, energize, and align people toward shared goals
Strong business development mindset and experience in building partnerships
A clear purpose, a unique offer, and a range of flexible compensation and other benefits such as:
Personal growth & challenging work with endless opportunities to fulfill your ambitions
An informal, dynamic environment with innovative colleagues who support your efforts
At ING Lease, you can count on a wide range of opportunities to invest in your personal and professional growth
We are redefining leasing. Are you in?
There has never been a more interesting time to work at ING Lease. We are on a journey focused on our customers, driven by technology, and led by intelligent, determined people. Our customers feel that our people enable them to stay one step ahead in life and business. And we are proud of that.
ING’s vision is to unlock our people’s full potential through our inclusive culture where everyone has the opportunity to develop and have impact for our customers and society. To achieve this vision, our policies support diversity, equity, and inclusion. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind with regard to age, gender, gender identity, cultural background, experience, religion, race, ethnicity, disability, family responsibilities, sexual orientation, social origin, or any other status protected by applicable law. If you require any assistance or if we can accommodate you in any way when participating in our application and/or interview process, please email the recruiting contact listed for the relevant position. We will be happy to work with you to ensure a fair and accessible process. Read more about our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging here.
